```{julia}
df_last.unique_ratio  = df_last.unique_specialist ./ df_last.n_bees

df_last.any_exactly_diff    = df_last.any_ratio - df_last.exactly_ratio
df_last.exactly_unique_diff = df_last.exactly_ratio - df_last.unique_ratio
```

```{julia}
using CairoMakie

function grid_from_df_nan(df::DataFrame; x=:interaction_rate, y=:dead_time, z=:any_ratio_mean)
    xs = sort(unique(df[!, x]))
    ys = sort(unique(df[!, y]))
    x_to_i = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(xs))
    y_to_j = Dict(v => j for (j,v) in enumerate(ys))

    Z = fill(NaN, length(xs), length(ys))
    for r in eachrow(df)
        v = r[z]
        Z[x_to_i[r[x]], y_to_j[r[y]]] = ismissing(v) ? NaN : float(v)
    end
    return xs, ys, Z
end
```

```{julia}
function log_edges(v::AbstractVector{<:Real})
    v = sort(unique(float.(v)))
    @assert all(v .> 0) "log_edges requires strictly positive coordinates."

    n = length(v)
    e = similar(v, n + 1)

    # interior edges: geometric means
    for i in 2:n
        e[i] = sqrt(v[i-1] * v[i])
    end

    # extrapolate first/last edges by preserving local ratio
    e[1]   = v[1]^2 / e[2]
    e[end] = v[end]^2 / e[end-1]

    # safety (numerical)
    if e[1] <= 0
        e[1] = v[1] / (v[2]/v[1])
    end
    return e
end
```

```{julia}
using CairoMakie
using DataFrames

function plot_heatmap_loglog_flipped(df::DataFrame;
    alpha=:interaction_rate,
    tau=:dead_time,
    z::Symbol,
    xlabel="Refractory time, τ",
    ylabel="Suppression-rate prefactor, α",
    cbar_label="",
    labelsize=36,
    ticksize=32,
    contour_level=nothing,
    colorscale::Function = identity,
    nan_color = (:gray90, 1.0),

    # optional extras (set to `nothing` to disable)
    colorrange::Union{Nothing,Tuple{<:Real,<:Real}} = nothing,
    highclip = nothing,   # e.g. :black
    lowclip  = nothing,   # e.g. :white
    cb_ticks = nothing,   # e.g. [0, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000]
    cb_tickformat = xs -> string.(round.(Int, xs))
)
    df2 = filter(r -> r[alpha] > 0 && r[tau] > 0, df)

    # build grid (NaN for missing)
    xs = sort(unique(df2[!, alpha]))
    ys = sort(unique(df2[!, tau]))
    x_to_i = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(xs))
    y_to_j = Dict(v => j for (j,v) in enumerate(ys))

    Z = fill(NaN, length(xs), length(ys))
    for r in eachrow(df2)
        v = r[z]
        if !ismissing(v)
            Z[x_to_i[r[alpha]], y_to_j[r[tau]]] = Float32(v)
        end
    end

    fig = Figure(size=(1000, 720))
    #ax = Axis(fig[1,1];
        #xscale=log10,
        #yscale=log10,
        #xlabel=xlabel,
        #ylabel=ylabel,
        #xlabelsize=labelsize,
        #ylabelsize=labelsize,
        #xticklabelsize=ticksize,
        #yticklabelsize=ticksize
    #)
    ax = Axis(fig[1,1];
        xscale=log10,
        yscale=log10,
        xautolimitmargin=(0, 0),
        yautolimitmargin=(0, 0),
        xlabel=xlabel,
        ylabel=ylabel,
        xlabelsize=labelsize,
        ylabelsize=labelsize,
        xticklabelsize=ticksize,
        yticklabelsize=ticksize
    )

    xmin, xmax = minimum(ys), maximum(ys)   # x-axis is taus/etas because you plot heatmap!(ax, ys, xs, Z')
    ymin, ymax = minimum(xs), maximum(xs)

    xlims!(ax, xmin, xmax)
    ylims!(ax, ymin, ymax)

    # --- build heatmap kwargs safely ---
    hm_kwargs = Dict{Symbol,Any}(
        :nan_color => nan_color,
        :colorscale => colorscale,
    )
    if colorrange !== nothing
        hm_kwargs[:colorrange] = colorrange
    end
    if highclip !== nothing
        hm_kwargs[:highclip] = highclip
    end
    if lowclip !== nothing
        hm_kwargs[:lowclip] = lowclip
    end

    # x-axis is ys (tau / eta), y-axis is xs (alpha / alpha*tau)
    xedges = log_edges(ys)
    yedges = log_edges(xs)

    hm = heatmap!(ax, xedges, yedges, Z';
        hm_kwargs...
        #nan_color = (:gray90, 1.0),
        #colorscale = colorscale,
        #colorrange = colorrange,
    )

    #hm = heatmap!(ax, ys, xs, Z'; hm_kwargs...)  # x=taus, y=alphas

    if contour_level !== nothing
        contour!(ax, ys, xs, Z'; levels=[contour_level], linewidth=3)
    end

    # --- Colorbar kwargs ---
    cb_kwargs = Dict{Symbol,Any}(
        :label => cbar_label,
        :labelsize => labelsize,
        :ticklabelsize => ticksize,
    )
    if cb_ticks !== nothing
        cb_kwargs[:ticks] = cb_ticks
        cb_kwargs[:tickformat] = cb_tickformat
    end

    Colorbar(fig[1,2], hm; cb_kwargs...)

    return fig
end
```

```{julia}
function plot_heatmap_loglog_flipped(df::DataFrame;
    alpha=:interaction_rate,
    tau=:dead_time,
    z::Symbol,
    xlabel="Refractory time, τ",
    ylabel="Suppression-rate prefactor, α",
    cbar_label="",
    labelsize=34,
    ticksize=30,
    contour_level=nothing,          # e.g. 0.9 for coverage
    colorscale=nothing,             # e.g. log10
    nan_color=:transparent
)
    df2 = filter(r -> r[alpha] > 0 && r[tau] > 0 && !ismissing(r[z]), df)

    alphas, taus, Z = grid_from_df_nan(df2; x=alpha, y=tau, z=z)

    fig = Figure(size=(1000, 720))
    ax = Axis(fig[1,1];
        xscale=log10,
        yscale=log10,
        xlabel=xlabel,
        ylabel=ylabel,
        xlabelsize=labelsize,
        ylabelsize=labelsize,
        xticklabelsize=ticksize,
        yticklabelsize=ticksize,
    )

    hm = heatmap!(ax, taus, alphas, Z';
        nan_color=nan_color,
        colorscale=colorscale
    )

    if contour_level !== nothing
        contour!(ax, taus, alphas, Z'; levels=[contour_level], linewidth=3)
    end

    Colorbar(fig[1,2], hm;
        label=cbar_label,
        labelsize=labelsize,
        ticklabelsize=ticksize
    )

    fig
end
```

```{julia}
using CairoMakie

function plot_heatmap_loglog_flipped(df::DataFrame;
    alpha=:interaction_rate,
    tau=:dead_time,
    z::Symbol,
    xlabel="Refractory time, τ",
    ylabel="Suppression-rate prefactor, α",
    cbar_label="",
    labelsize=36,
    ticksize=32,
    contour_level=nothing,              # e.g. 0.9
    colorscale::Function = identity,    # <-- IMPORTANT
    nan_color = (:black, 0.0)           # transparent
)
    df2 = filter(r -> r[alpha] > 0 && r[tau] > 0, df)

    # build grid (NaN for missing)
    xs = sort(unique(df2[!, alpha]))
    ys = sort(unique(df2[!, tau]))
    x_to_i = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(xs))
    y_to_j = Dict(v => j for (j,v) in enumerate(ys))

    Z = fill(NaN, length(xs), length(ys))
    for r in eachrow(df2)
        v = r[z]
        if !ismissing(v)
            Z[x_to_i[r[alpha]], y_to_j[r[tau]]] = float(v)
        end
    end

    fig = Figure(size=(1000, 720))
    ax = Axis(fig[1,1];
        xscale=log10,
        yscale=log10,
        xlabel=xlabel,
        ylabel=ylabel,
        xlabelsize=labelsize,
        ylabelsize=labelsize,
        xticklabelsize=ticksize,
        yticklabelsize=ticksize
    )

    hm = heatmap!(ax, ys, xs, Z';    # x=taus, y=alphas
        #nan_color=nan_color,
        nan_color = (:gray90, 1.0),   # or :lightgray
        colorscale=colorscale
        #colorscale = log10
    )

    if contour_level !== nothing
        contour!(ax, ys, xs, Z'; levels=[contour_level], linewidth=3)
    end

    cb_ticks = [0, 2000, 4000, 6000, 8000]
    Colorbar(fig[1,2], hm;
        label = cbar_label,
        ticks = cb_ticks,
        labelsize = labelsize,
        ticklabelsize = ticksize
    )

    return fig
end
```
